integrity: Proof supplied for all positive moduli. Exact finite verification reproduces 1999 modular comparisons; finite checks are not infinite proofs. No independent mathematical audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Counts distinct modular image values, not integral square-triangular solutions or numbers of representations; no bound on the global size of nonsquare excess is asserted. Historical priority remains uncertain, and publisher access limited exhaustive review of the 2022 paper.
title: Exact square–triangular residue overlap and nonsquare excess at every modulus
